title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - reference catalog schema
description: Schema for request-selectable LDSC and LDAK reference bundles.

reference_ld_scores.description: LDSC `--ref-ld-chr` stem, written exactly as it would be typed. LDSC completes it with `<chr>.l2.ldscore.gz` and `<chr>.l2.M_5_50`, so `/refs/ldsc/eur_w_ld_chr/` names `/refs/ldsc/eur_w_ld_chr/1.l2.ldscore.gz` and `/refs/ldsc/baseline/baselineLD.` names `/refs/ldsc/baseline/baselineLD.1.l2.ldscore.gz`. The text before the last `/` is the staged directory and must exist; the text after it is the file-name prefix and may be empty.

regression_weights.description: LDSC `--w-ld-chr` stem, written exactly as it would be typed. LDSC completes it with `<chr>.l2.ldscore.gz`, so `/refs/ldsc/eur_w_ld_chr/` names `/refs/ldsc/eur_w_ld_chr/1.l2.ldscore.gz` and `/refs/ldsc/weights/weights.hm3_noMHC.` names `/refs/ldsc/weights/weights.hm3_noMHC.1.l2.ldscore.gz`. The text before the last `/` is the staged directory and must exist; the text after it is the file-name prefix and may be empty.
